conflicts: The anchor reads approximately 23–26 rather than a boyish 19: the long, sharply defined jaw and mature cheek structure conflict with Mostafa’s stated age and soft oval face with a narrow pointed chin.
The thick, relatively long top and the signature 'thick tousled hair' conflict with the consistently short regulation haircut required for a bare-headed Egyptian commando.

issues: Photorealistic with credible Egyptian features, correct anatomy, natural-enough skin, and no visible text or artifacts.
The face is angular and mature rather than boyish and oval, and the chin is more squared than narrowly pointed.
The highly polished, symmetrical portrait and dramatic eye treatment read somewhat like an editorial model photograph rather than an ordinary young private.
The hair needs to be cropped shorter and more evenly for the military role.
exhausted@133352 and soaking-wet@133352 look substantially older and more gaunt than the anchor, with pronounced stubble, altered jaw definition, and different nose proportions.
shouting@133352 shifts the eye color toward light hazel and lengthens the face; three-quarter-left-sun@133352 has a broader, rounder lower face than the anchor.
Facial stubble in exhausted@133352 and especially soaking-wet@133352 can bake an older, unshaven appearance into a clean-shaven 19-year-old character.
headwear@133352 hides the regulation haircut and introduces a cap that the bare-headed commando role must not wear.
The caption for front-closeup@133352 is truncated at 'cott' and must be repaired.

The set has useful expression, angle, lighting, full-body, and action variation, but beige shirts, scarves, and desert portrait settings recur too often and risk baking the anchor styling into the face.
There is no clean reference of the redesigned actor in a plain 1973 Egyptian field uniform or under marsh-march conditions, despite those being the character’s dominant screen contexts.

redesign_change: Keep his Egyptian identity, warm olive-brown skin, large dark almond eyes, straight medium nose, full lips and strong brows, but give him a visibly boyish 19-year-old oval face with a softer jaw and narrow pointed chin, and replace the thick tousled top with an evenly close-cropped short black 1973 regulation army haircut.
summary: The actor is regionally plausible and the images are mostly photoreal, but the approved look is too mature and angular for Mostafa and its signature hair conflicts with commando grooming; redesign the age structure and haircut, then rebuild the drifting and contaminated references.
name: Karim Nour
